Isolotto Sud — Florence, Italy

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

The Isolotto public-housing district (Quartiere 4) has seen genuine, serious documented incidents in 2025-2026: an armed confrontation between rival groups with several shots fired in a piazza (described by press as part of an ongoing 'gang war'), a robbery/theft arrest of a 55-year-old, and, most seriously, a 2026 knife attack on a father in front of his 10-year-old son during a street robbery attempt. Local press generally refers to these as happening 'at the Isolotto' without distinguishing between the Nord and Sud administrative sub-zones, so this rating is applied to both with that caveat noted honestly. Sources checked: La Nazione, 'Firenze, follia maranza: agguato con la pistola, sei spari in piazza' (Isolotto); ANSA Toscana, robbery arrest at Isolotto (July 2025); Il Fatto Quotidiano, father stabbed by baby gang in front of son at Isolotto (April 2026).

This rating comes from a structured local-source assessment. This specific area was reviewed against credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — and the signals were consolidated across sources rather than taken from any single report, with the reasoning and the sources shown above. Florence publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does publish one, Wandroz uses it instead of an assessment. Where a review finds nothing documented, that is recorded as no findings rather than as a safety rating.

Frequently asked questions

Is Isolotto Sud safe?

Wandroz currently rates Isolotto Sud in Florence as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Florence during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Florence at night. This comes from a structured local-source assessment: an area-level review of credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — consolidated across sources rather than taken from a single report. Florence publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does, Wandroz uses it instead.

Is Isolotto Sud safe at night?

At night, Isolotto Sud is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Florence. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Isolotto Sud a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Isolotto Sud's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Florence) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. Is there official crime data for Isolotto Sud?

Not an official government crime feed — Isolotto Sud's rating comes from Wandroz's own current local/national press and survey research for this specific area instead (see the note on this page for what was checked and the sources used).
